title: DeskGrantConstraintsV1
description: The limits on an organization's grant to administer its desks: `api.write` on `apis/desks`. They are stored on the grant, copied by Govern into the signed gate token's `constraints`, and enforced by the backend adapter before any backend call. CLOSED: an unknown key is refused, never ignored, because an ignored limit is a limit nobody enforces. Every list the adapter needs in order to allow anything is required and non-empty: no list, no create. Rules a schema cannot state are the adapter's, and refuse with the code naming the limit: every name in `providers` has an entry in `provider_config_digests`, and no other name does; a create's image digest (after `@`, or the whole value when it is a local content ID) is in `image_digests`; every host in `policy_baseline.network.allowed_hosts` is inside the `allowed_hosts` ceiling.

image_digests.description: The images a desk may be created from, by digest: a registry digest for an image from a registry, or the local content ID (Docker's image ID) for an image the machine built itself. They are different hashes of one image; list the one the create names. A create whose image digest is not here is refused CONSTRAINT_IMAGE_DIGESTS.

policy_digests.description: The reviewed BASELINE policies a create may start from, by the digest the adapter computes. They govern a create only; later changes are held to `allowed_hosts`.

allowed_hosts.description: The ceiling: every host any desk policy allows, at create and after every later change, must be one of these, or under a `*.` entry. A change that reaches outside it is refused CONSTRAINT_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

providers.description: The providers a desk may have attached. Empty means none.

provider_config_digests.description: For each provider, the digest of the configuration the Enclave accepted at install. An attach or detach of a provider whose configuration no longer matches is refused CONSTRAINT_PROVIDER_CONFIG_DIGESTS.

environment_keys.description: The environment names a create may set. Empty means none.

repo_hosts.description: Unused since 0.65.0: a create carries no repository (repositories reach a desk through a setup plan), so nothing reads this limit. It stays required so every grant written before stays valid; write [].

policy_baseline.description: What every desk policy, at create and after every change, must keep. The adapter compares the RESULTING policy with it, not only the request.

must_equal.description: The parts of a policy that may never differ from the baseline a desk started from: filesystem access, process identity, user namespaces, enforcement mode, and driver and runtime settings. All six, always: leaving one out would let a change reach it.

allowed_hosts.description: The hosts the baseline policy itself allows. Each is inside the `allowed_hosts` ceiling.

allowed_ports.description: The only ports any network rule may name, for example 443 and 22.

allowed_cidrs.description: Address ranges a network rule may name. Empty means none: a rule names hosts.

provider_added.description: A change may add the network access a provider needs only for a provider in `providers`.

requires_role.description: The organization role a run must have been started by for Govern to sign a token from this grant. Govern checks it when the grant is used; the adapter does not.
